description: This file defines functions related to replacing certain PyTorch JIT graph operations with variadic versions, specifically handling list mutation operations and variadic counterparts for cat, stack, and other variadic ops.

methods.name: UseVariadicOp
methods.description: Replaces a graph operation with a variadic version if possible.

methods.name: RemoveListMutationAndUseVariadicOp
methods.description: Removes list mutation and replaces the operation with its variadic form.

methods.name: UseVariadicCat
methods.description: Replaces aten::cat with its variadic version in the graph.

methods.name: RemoveListMutationAndUseVariadicCat
methods.description: Removes list mutation and replaces aten::cat with its variadic form.

methods.name: UseVariadicStack
methods.description: Replaces aten::stack with its variadic version.

methods.name: RemoveListMutationAndUseVariadicStack
methods.description: Removes list mutation and replaces aten::stack with its variadic form.
